name: Slow Cooker Cider-Poached Pears with Vanilla Ice Cream

instructions.primary_message: Chop ginger into small pieces. Place in a 4-quart slow cooker insert.
Break cinnamon stick in half. Add to the insert along with star anise, cloves, apple juice, and honey. Stir to combine the poaching liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cinnamon stick
2 star anise, whole
2 cups apple juice
¼ cup honey

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, peel, and halve pears lengthwise. Working one at a time, use a sharp paring knife, melon baller, or metal measuring spoon to cut out the core. Add pears to the insert, cover, and cook until tender, about 2 hours on high.
When the pears are tender, use a slotted spoon to remove to a plate, leaving the poaching liquid in the insert.
Strain poaching liquid into a medium saucepan using a fine mesh strainer. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer until the sauce is thick and syrupy, 20-25 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly, 10 minutes.
To serve, divide ice cream and pears between bowls. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
